built_for: #change Locate screen — current state (extent / condition / change)
licence: CC BY 4.0 upstream (Goldberg ORNL DAAC 1768 mangrove loss drivers; Dynamic World built modal). Non-commercial / research P2.
resolution_plain: Overlays are generalised open samples (~100–300 m after simplify). They are coarser than the Read screen’s ~10 m class polygons. They fade past about zoom 11.5 so blocky edges do not look like broken fine data beside Satellite.

state_gaps.plain: No live mangrove stock / annual extent layer on Locate. Global Mangrove Watch annual extent remains a documented data need. Use Satellite for the shore; Read shortlists open/accreted patches, not full extent.
No mangrove condition, health, or degradation score ships on this console.
Open coastal samples only: 2000–2016 loss drivers and a built-up proxy. Not an annual change time slider or multi-epoch urban expansion series.

layers.title: Mangrove loss drivers
layers.resolution_plain: Goldberg loss drivers, coastal sample, simplified for the public stub (~150 m display). Coarser than Read’s 10 m class map.
layers.note: Open coastal sample of ORNL DAAC mangrove loss drivers (2000–2016). Not GMW annual change — data need for time slider.

layers.title: Built-up / urban change
layers.resolution_plain: Dynamic World built modal, coastal sample, simplified for the public stub (~200 m display). Pressure context only.
layers.note: Open coastal sample of Dynamic World modal built (class 6). GHS-BUILT multi-epoch remains a data need.
